listing.name: Arthr's Ships n' Shit - pre-release 0.100
listing.summary: after 9 years in development I return to you with 2 new ships, 1 halfbaked gameplay system and 4 short missions making this a vanilla-quality mod
listing.aiSummary: Adds mobile battle colonies, new ships and weapons, and pirate interactions.

description: Introduces two new ships, a gameplay system involving mobile and upgradable battle colonies, and four short missions. It also modifies pirate behavior so they request items rather than attacking immediately.
